messages:
ananya: heads-up — after the phi-mini-13b quant+int8 rollout to staging, we're seeing sporadic OOMs on convo workloads with long turns. started ~0900 UTC, 5% of requests fail.
kevin: repro logs? sequence lengths?
ananya: mostly user chats with many follow-ups. avg input tokens ~1200, reply target ~512. backend shows 'out of memory allocating KV cache' then oom kill. attaching snippet: ```stderr
E tensorflow: allocation failed: 0x7f...
OOM when trying to allocate 256MB for KV cache at step 34
```
olivia: is this new after quantization? or just surfaced because memory footprint changed?
ananya: seems tied to the int8 build — we switched kernel packing and reduced peak by ~1.6x for short sequences, but KV layout changed, and prefetch window default was left at 4 (we use prefetch=4 for most models).
matt: prefetch window of 4 + continuous batching can multiply KV cache per-slot. if batcher groups 8 concurrent streams with prefetch=4, that's 32 simultaneous KV slots worth. on 13B that adds up.
kevin: can we reduce prefetch to 1 or disable for the phi-mini int8 variant to test?
ananya: just tried a quick A/B: prefetch=1 on a small pool — no OOMs in 2k requests. latency +3ms median, p95 +10ms.
olivia: good sign. need a safer default for onboarding new quant models. maybe we flip prefetch default to 1 for any quantized build unless explicitly overridden.
matt: also check max_new_tokens defaults — some SDKs set 1024 previously for internal tests. combined with large input lengths that creates huge KV lengths. we should cap default max_new_tokens to 256 for convo-compatible variants.
anke: (typo, meant ananya) ananya: agreed. we have three knobs: prefetch window, max_new_tokens default, and batcher max_new_streams. propose immediate mitigations: 1) set prefetch=1 on phi-mini-13b-int8 rollout; 2) set platform default max_new_tokens=256 for all "chatty" model configs; 3) add a model metadata flag "kv_sensitivity": high/medium/low so routing + autoscaler can prioritize.
kevin: quick patch for rollout: updated model config -> `prefetch_window: 1` and `default_max_new_tokens: 256` for phi-mini-13b-int8. rolling to 4 nodes now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: model-config/phi-mini-13b-int8@2026-03-20T09:17:00Z -> 4 nodes.
ananya: monitoring — so far 45m no OOMs, error rate back to baseline. can we add an instrumentation point to log per-request KV slots used? that would help future triage.
matt: yes we can add a small metric: kv_slots_allocated = ceil((input_len + max_new_tokens)/chunk_size) * prefetch_window * active_streams_in_batcher  — approximate. I'll add to runtime exporter.
olivia: related: memory fragmentation still a thing on long-lived pods. for int8 runtimes, allocator fragmentation can cause OOM even when raw free memory > needed. suggestion: force periodic process restart after N requests or N seconds, or use jemalloc tunables. thoughts?
anke: (again) ananya: for production we prefer graceful restarts at low-traffic windows. but for dedicated pools we can instead enable jemalloc background purge and tunings. we'll document recommended allocator settings in the model onboarding checklist.
kevin: also run a short benchmark comparing prefetch=1 vs 4 across latency and cost for typical PLG chat workload. want numbers to justify default change.
ananya: I'll run the benchmark suite today and drop results in this thread. early numbers: prefetch=1 increases token cost ~1.03x but reduces outage risk.
matt: adding note — for models with very small KV chunk_size (e.g., that new kernel), the multiplier is worse. we should detect chunk_size and mark kv_sensitivity automatically.
olivia: agreed. next action items: ananya — bench & result post; matt — add kv_slots metric + auto-sensitivity heuristic; kevin — keep phi-mini rollout on prefetch=1 and monitor 24h; olivia — update onboarding checklist draft with allocator and default knobs.
ananya: on it. will post bench CSV link here when done. :thumbsup:
kevin: awesome, thanks. once we have numbers we can push a small platform default change and a release note for eng teams.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: model-config/phi-mini-13b-int8 applied to 4 nodes @2026-03-20T09:21:15Z
ananya: posted bench results: https://internal.redwood/bench/phi-mini-13b-int8/prefetch-experiment.csv — summary in thread below.
matt: thanks — initial look: prefetch=1 p95 latency +12ms, cost +3.5%, OOM incidents 0 vs 6 in baseline. looks like a net win for stability.
olivia: great, let's proceed with onboarding checklist updates and add an automated check during model onboarding that runs the prefetch sensitivity sweep.
ananya: agreed. I'll create a short PR to the onboarding docs and include the mitigation recipe.
